description: Use when an agent must decide whether whoever is talking to it really controls a wallet: it recovers the address that signed a personal_sign (EIP-191) message and says whether it matches the one you expected. This is the check that turns a claimed address into a proven one. Do not use for EIP-712 typed data or for a contract signature (ERC-1271): this route verifies personal_sign. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

expected.description: Optional address to compare the recovered signer against.

message.description: The exact message that was signed.

name: util_verify_signature
title: Verify wallet signature
